title: Server errors and focus
objective: Represent authoritative HTTP errors in accessible form feedback and restore focus to the first relevant input.
predict: A 422 response must never show success; the title field should be focused and identified as invalid, with role alert text.
expectedBehavior: Mock 422 then 503. The 422 path must set title error and focus; 503 must set root.server without claiming success.
commonFailure: The starter treats a fetch response as success without checking response.ok.
securityBoundary: Never print untrusted server error bodies as HTML; use trusted generic descriptions and text nodes for any constrained message.
